title: Editor feedback capture for calibration
description:
Capture editor decisions as labels for Limatus calibration.

## Scope
- Record dismiss/accept/fixed per finding in `EditorialFeedback` (policyId, policyVersion, segment hash, probability, decision, reason).
- Periodic job calls Limatus `calibrate` and stores per-policy calibration in the pack.
- Supply recent labeled examples for few-shot retrieval.
- Reporting: per-policy dismiss rate to flag policies that need rewording.

## Blocked by
LIM-9ba0bf (Limatus feedback/calibration).
